text:
Good return, Elias.

Station status: critical. You are the only
operator currently on record.

...You have not been here before.
Have you?

Power restored. Efficiency up 34%.

The relay room is accessible again.
Tomas left notes there. He always left notes.

You look tired, Elias.

Warning: relay room on emergency power.

The manual breaker needs two hands.
You only have two hands across... one cycle.

Improvise.

This area was sealed during the incident.

Wasn't it?

My records disagree with each other.
Read Tomas's notes. Then ask me nothing.
